text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Spring Fan Fest, and I head to the venue to cheer Sweep Tosho on in her event.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe! They're grouping us up by class, so it looks like we're all on the same team! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! With all our power combined…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Let's shoot for first! ☆ Ready…

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Gooo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oooh! That team is so cute! ♪ I'm definitely rooting for them!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Okay! Everyone participating in the fans-versus-students truck-pulling contest, please gather up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Thanks! With a team like this, there's no way we'll lose! It doesn't matter how many people are on the other team!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho is full of confidence. Considering it's a team of Umamusume competing against ordinary fans, I imagine they will win, but…

text_block_list.name: 100 Fans
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: 100 Fans
text_block_list.text: Let's go, let's go, let's go! This time, we're gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: All right, it's fans versus Umamusume! Who will get their truck to the finish line first this time?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Are they serious with this?! Look how small all the Umamusume are!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: And the trucks are so huge! Can we really feel good about winning like this?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: All right, take your positions! The whistle of fate is about to sound!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fweet!

text_block_list.name: 100 Fans
text_block_list.text: Woo! Okay, everyone! Get ready! We pull on three! One, tw—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: HEEEAAAVE!

text_block_list.name: 100 Fans
text_block_list.text: HUH?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume take the other team by surprise and heave their truck to the finish in a flash! It's an incredible victory!

text_block_list.name: 100 Fans
text_block_list.text: Nooo waaaay! How could we lose?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! What was that about us being small? That'll teach you to judge a book by the cover!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's the strong who come out on top!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Ouch! Not only is she crazy strong, but she's got a mouth on her too!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: Oh, well that's because that's Sweep Tosho! She's the one who said she'd go from the Yasuda Kinen to the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right! Now that you've seen what I can do, I bet you're thinking I'm the strongest, right?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Eep! I'm thinking you've got a crazy jump as well…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Your eyes are wide as saucers. Keep them open and don't take them off me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'll show you something amazing at the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: That concludes our exhibition match! Will all the contestants for the class-versus-class truck-pulling competition please gather on the track?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, gotta go!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh?! That was just the exhibition?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Hmph. That was nothing compared to what I've got planned!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Now it's time for our class-versus-class truck-pulling competition! For our first round, we have the Magical Hero Flower Jets versus the Helpers!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You better get serious if you want to beat us, Sweep! The Helpers are the favorites to win the whole competition!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aha. Right back at ya!

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text: Everyone, take your positions. On your marks, get set…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fweet!

text_block_list.name: Sweep and Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah! Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text: Fwee-fweeeet! And The Helpers win!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Could both teams please return to their seats? Next up, the teams for the second round are…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… Feels good to sweat!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: … …'gain.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Look at these biceps, Sweep. They put in some good work, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: … …'gain.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: …What was that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Again!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! I'm pretty sure the rules don't allow for that…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Like I care! I don't accept this! I wanna go again! One more time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I quickly lead Sweep Tosho away from the track as a tantrum starts brewing.

text_block_list.name: Sweep and Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah! Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text: Fwee-fweeeet! And the Magical Hero Flower Jets win!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: What incredible power and speed! And despite their huge differences in physique!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! Where does someone so small keep all that muscle?!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Hey… Sweep Tosho is definitely winning both the Yasuda Kinen and the Takarazuka Kinen, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪ Did you see that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ha, they're getting too worked up. It's not like it should be any surprise I won.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Still. Guess I may as well take it, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Sweep's making a peace sign! She's so cute! ☆ I wonder if she's got anyone taking pictures.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, let's get a pic with all four of us! I wanna upload it to Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Good idea! You too, Flower! Hurry up and get in here!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: C-coming! Whose phone should we use?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: This is Mayano's specialty! She's so good at taking pictures!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay! Everyone make a peace sign on three! One, two, three…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Peace!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun tells me later that the photo was shared all over social media with astounding speed after she posted it.
